configuration.corruption_library_protocol: 224x224 uint8 input; official corruption names and severities
configuration.benchmark_label: ImageNet-C-compatible corruptions generated on held-out ImageNet validation images; not the pre-generated official ImageNet-C archive

limitations: This uses the standardized imagecorruptions implementation, not the downloaded official ImageNet-C JPEG archive.
The reserved ImageNet validation range is disjoint from the locked SAE, adapter, and router development splits.
Later exploratory work may have inspected parts of the nominal reserve, so this is a controlled confirmation benchmark rather than a pristine final test set.
